theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < r → Continuous g → (∀ t : ℝ, r ^ 2 ≤ t → g t = 0) → ∃ Ψ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport Ψ ∧ tsupport Ψ ⊆ closedBall 0 r ∧ ∀ y v : Euclid n, fderiv ℝ Ψ y v = g (‖y‖ ^ 2) * inner ℝ y v
